about_the_game:
Only Down: Gravitation Up is a game in which you will have to go through all the stages of human evolution all over AGAIN. And what will happen in the end? Dinosaurs, do you think? And here you will find out...

The game is in the "Only Up" style, which has a reverse form. You will have to constantly go down and avoid huge fans that will interfere with you in every possible way and lift you up, which is strictly forbidden!

Game Features:

  • The reverse "OnlyUp" style;

  • Gameplay lasts for more than 2 hours;

  • The various complexities of parkour;

  • Historical events hidden behind non-verbal signs;

  • A unique change of characters adapted to a particular historical event;

  • The game, in addition to the usual downward descent, has a hidden meaning, showing the entire evolution of mankind. Fans symbolize the obstacles in life that people have overcome.;

  • Well-designed locations, day and night alternation, character animations!

It's time to sink to the bottom, good luck!
